spots.name: Rock Harbor Lighthouse
spots.tip: Lighthouses make strong silhouettes at dusk and pair well with blue hour once the light is on.

spots.name: Passage Island Lighthouse
spots.tip: Lighthouses make strong silhouettes at dusk and pair well with blue hour once the light is on.

spots.name: Ojibway Fire Tower
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented.

spots.name: Isle Royale NP
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 202 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L443388.

spots.name: Isle Royale NP: Rock Harbor VC
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 129 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L3021003.

spots.name: Amygdaloid Arch
spots.tip: A natural arch. Low side light at either end of the day brings out the rock texture; at night it can frame the Milky Way.

spots.name: Isle Royale NP: Scoville Point Trail
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 117 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L3021021.

spots.name: Mount Ojibway
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 345 m (1,132 ft).

spots.name: Angleworm Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: Lookout Louise
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Suzys Cave
spots.tip: A cave entrance. Bring a headlamp and a tripod; light from the opening makes the picture. Check whether it's closed for bats or ice.
